summary: In the Operator enterprise topology, CR defaults match the reference deployment for production. Pods have minimum requests and no limits; AAP runs on a ROSA HCP cluster with 2 t3.xlarge workers in 2 AZs, and controller task pod capacity comes from the worker node it runs on.
questions: What cluster runs the Operator enterprise reference topology?
How is controller task pod capacity determined on ROSA?
Does the AAP Operator set CPU limits in the enterprise topology?
